parsed.summary: The patch addresses the race condition by handling FileNotFoundError, but it may introduce a behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The patch changes the behavior of `has_key` to return `False` on `FileNotFoundError`, which might not be the expected behavior in all cases. It could potentially mask other issues or change the semantics of the function.
